headline: Approved contracts for VMware software ($198,720), sales consulting ($30,000), NPD body cameras ($5,699,999.83), and NPD firearms equipment ($47,815)
summary: The Finance Committee approved four contracts: a VMware vSphere Foundation renewal, a sales qualification consulting contract, a purchase of Axon body worn and fleet cameras for the Police Department, and a purchase of firearms training equipment for the Police Department. The committee also found it had complied with charter requirements on the record of expenditures from July 31, 2026 through August 13, 2026.
decisions: Approved a 3 year contract renewal for VMware vSphere Foundation through GovConnection, Inc. not to exceed $198,720.
Approved a contract with Vincent Consulting for reviewing, validating and qualifying sales not to exceed $30,000.
Approved purchase of Axon OSP 10 body worn, fleet, interview room cameras and digital evidence platform with Axon Enterprise, Inc. not to exceed $5,699,999.83.
Approved purchase of operational equipment and supplies for the NPD Firearms Training Unit with Atlantic Tactical not to exceed $47,815.
Approved that the Finance Committee complied with the City Charter and ordinances on the record of expenditures from July 31, 2026 through August 13, 2026.
